arguments.need: I used to own an old HP 12C financial calculator and an HP 67, and I miss working with RPN on the real key layouts. I'm looking for a desktop program that emulates those classic HP models faithfully, not just a generic RPN calculator. I'd like to be able to save the calculator's state to a file and load it back later, and ideally load program cards for the 67. It would also help if I can make the window bigger, since the buttons look tiny on my screen.
